Why Halcyon
10+ Years in Pain Medicine US FDA-Approved COOLIEF Cooled RF CIPS — World Institute of Pain, USA Ultrasound-Guided Precision Day-Care Procedures No General Anaesthesia 10+ Years in Pain Medicine US FDA-Approved COOLIEF Cooled RF CIPS — World Institute of Pain, USA Ultrasound-Guided Precision Day-Care Procedures No General Anaesthesia

Pain that lasts is rarely where it hurts. Halcyon finds the source, then treats it without a scalpel. Four interventional pathways — all image-guided, all day-care.

  1. 01 Regenerative Medicine

    Growth Factor Concentrate is drawn from the patient's own blood, concentrated, and placed under ultrasound exactly where the tissue has worn. The body does the repairing.

    Explore regenerative medicine

  2. 02 Radiofrequency Ablation

    A precise current interrupts the nerve carrying the pain signal. For knee pain Halcyon uses the US FDA-approved second-generation COOLIEF cooled-RF system.

    Explore radiofrequency ablation

  3. 03 Prolotherapy

    A natural irritant is injected into a slack ligament or tendon to restart the body's own repair response. A short course of small injections, and nothing to recover from afterwards.

    Explore prolotherapy

  4. 04 Nerve Hydrodissection

    Ultrasound-guided fluid separates a trapped nerve from the tissue pressing on it. Relief often begins on the table, and the nerve itself is left intact.

    Explore hydrodissection & nerve blocks

Twelve kinds of pain. One non-surgical route out.

From an arthritic knee to a trapped nerve in the face — each with its own image-guided pathway.
